cursor_port.description: Port of the Cursor turn-stream listener; must differ from listen_port.

stream_stall_seconds.description: How long a streamed answer may sit unread by its client before it is aborted.

agentic_concurrency.description: Live agentic launches allowed at once; a further call is refused with 429.

engine.description: Engines the door may start or reach.

model.description: Optional capability declarations for a model id.

route.description: Pairings of an engine with an upstream and, where one applies, a model.

potluck.description: Where a donated upstream’s liveness is reported.

configsvc.description: The config web UI’s listener and login; engined only validates it.

id.description: Engine id; also names its state paths, so it may not contain "/" or start with ".".

disable.description: Turns this entry off without deleting it.

spec_dir.description: Overrides the shipped spec directory. A privilege decision: spec is trusted code.

models_dir.description: Host directory holding this engine’s model files.

models_max.description: Llama resident-model budget across roles; may not be below the number of keep_resident roles.

idle_stop_seconds.description: How long an engine may sit unheld before it stops.

drain_timeout_seconds.description: How long a comfy submission waits for the engine to be free before it is refused. Default 15 minutes.

ready_timeout_s.description: How long a start may take to pass its readiness probe.

agent_version.description: Agentic engines: the pinned CLI version, never "latest".

default_model.description: Claude and cursor engines: the route model the models menu marks as default.

model_refresh_seconds.description: Claude and cursor engines: how often the provider is asked which models it serves. Default 3600.

kind.description: For an engine that ships no spec directory: which built-in spec it takes.

args.description: Launch parameters for this engine; a route’s own args override them.

devices.description: Container engines: host devices passed through, replacing the spec’s list. An empty list means none (CPU-only).

group_add.description: Container engines: groups added to the container, replacing the spec’s list. An empty list means none.

env.description: Container engines: environment variables merged over the spec’s; a key replaces the spec’s entry of the same name.

id.description: Upstream id; "local" is reserved for this box and cannot carry base_url or secret.

secret.description: Keyring item whose value authenticates calls to this upstream.

egress.description: How far a call to this upstream travels: none (this box), lan or remote.

wire.description: The request shape this upstream speaks.

disable.description: Turns this entry off without deleting it.

inventory_max_age_seconds.description: How long a cached provider model list stays usable; required when a wildcard route names this upstream.

inventory_refresh_seconds.description: How often the provider model list is re-fetched; must be less than inventory_max_age_seconds.

headers.description: Extra headers sent on every remote hop; the auth header and Host are refused.

fingerprint.description: A potluck donation’s identity: 64 hex characters.

monthly_cap_usd.description: Cost ceiling per UTC month, from the cost the upstream itself reports.

exclude_models.description: Provider model ids made unavailable: globs (* ? ) over the full wire id, or /regex/.

header.description: Header that carries the resolved credential.

scheme.description: Auth prefix such as "Bearer"; absent sends the raw value.

input.description: Input modalities this model accepts, for example "text" or "image".

engine.description: Id of the engine this route runs on.

model.description: Model segment of the address; "*" expands the upstream’s catalog.

wire_model.description: The id the upstream knows, sent in place of model.

display_name.description: Human label a client may show; not an address.

upstream.description: Id of the upstream serving this route; absent means local.

filename.description: Model file under the engine’s models_dir.

vision.description: For a vision role: whether the model describes a scene or reads characters.

translate.description: Opts a speech route into the translations verb.

fim.description: Opts a local llama route into fill-in-the-middle completions.

keep_resident.description: Load this model at engine start and reload it whenever its role returns.

streaming.description: Overrides whether this route streams, against the engine spec.

slot_long_threshold.description: Token count at or above which a request goes to a long slot.

vision_bridge.description: Address of a vision route that captions image attachments for this chat route.

args.description: Launch parameters for this route; they override the engine’s.

disable.description: Turns this entry off without deleting it.

input.description: Input modalities this model accepts, for example "text" or "image".

disable.description: Turns this entry off without deleting it.

callback_url.description: Where a donated upstream’s liveness is reported.

callback_secret.description: Keyring item holding the callback bearer.

enable.description: Whether the config web UI may run.

host.description: Name or address clients dial the config web UI on. It always listens on loopback; a value that is not loopback is served over HTTPS by the engined-tls bridge (restart it after a change).

port.description: Port of the config web UI; must differ from listen_port and cursor_port.

password_hash.description: Optional static login hash from `engined --hash-password` (argon2id). Absent, the config UI mints a random token on every start and logs its URL.
